description:
The National Airspace Systems Integration Support (NISC) program at Leidos is seeking a Data Engineer to perform a variety of duties in connection with the management of SharePoint sites and the preparation of high-profile business intelligence documents and dashboards for FAA senior leaders, Lines of Businesses, or other external groups. The position will be supporting the Federal Aviation Administration's (FAA) Central Service Area (CSA) NISC support team with the goal of providing outstanding customer service to FAA customers, receiving NISC services throughout the central service area. This position is based in Fort Worth, Texas and is an exciting opportunity to use your experience helping the NISC mission.
 Primary Responsibilities for the position include: 
 Support through data reports/analytics by developing processes and procedures to align with automation, streamlining and efficiency initiatives
 Develop business intelligence reporting systems such as Tableau, Business Objects, Microsoft Excel, SharePoint and other Office products
 Design visual and interactive tools and dashboards tailored to organization requirements
 Develop databases that support web applications and web sites
 Analyze users’ needs to implement Web site content, graphics, performance, and capacity
 Write, design, edit web page content, or direct others producing content
 Design and implement dashboards and reports using Tableau Server 
 Translate business requirements into the design and implementation of features and functionality required to deliver the required results
 Assist with development of internal organization policies and procedures, which affect cross-functional activities and best practices
 Demonstrate independent ability to research, study, workflow and other means implementing automated processes
 Manage  SharePoint site and access shared drives to manage high priority projects and programs
 
 Basic Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s degree and 4 to 8 years of relevant experience in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Analytics, or a related analytical field. Experience in lieu of degree considered.
 Experience with managing multiple Databases
 Experience working with Tableau reports and dashboards
 Proficiency in data visualization, dashboard design and workflow
 Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office suite & SharePoint 
 Strong understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and database design principles
 Skilled in relational databases , SQL , and API-based data querying 
 Experience developing predictive algorithms, image classifiers, object detectors, and others
 Proficiency in data visualization and graphical applications (Power BI, etc.)
 Experience with major data science languages such as R and Python 
 Ability to manage and merge disparate data sources using R, Python, or SQL 
 Ability to get/maintain Public Trust clearance
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Exceptional coordination and collaboration skills
 Track record of active learning and creative problem solving
 Familiarity using GIT, SVN, Jira, or other version control technologies
 Experience with Azure cloud data analytics tools
 
 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.
 
 
 Original Posting: 
November 17, 2026 
 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.







 
 
 Pay Range: 
Pay Range $73,450.00 - $132,775.00 
 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.
